messages:
jamie_cs: Quick heads-up — BeaconHealth onboarding hit ~18% P95 latency regression over the last 48h vs baseline. Low churn so far but RTT spikes during activation windows. Thinking: small model swap to compact variant + split traffic routing + short canary. Need eng/sre alignment before we message the customer.

tara_engineer: can you paste the p95 numbers and which endpoints are hot? also any recent config changes?

jamie_cs: sure — summary: /chat endpoint p95 from 210ms -> 250ms, concurrency steady, token mix heavier (longer prompts). No deploys in the window. Hot routes: chat.default and chat.summarize. Link: https://redwood.metrics/beaconhealth/alerts (redacted)

eli_sre: thanks. sounds like TTL on prefix cache might be dropping under longer prompt tail. two quick options: 1) route summarize to compact-v2 (quantized int8) 70/30 for 1h canary, 2) keep majority on standard but enable small prefetched KV caching for frequent prompts. both need a short rollback policy.

jamie_cs: +1 to option 1 as low-friction. customer is mid-activation and cost-sensitive; want latency improvement without big accuracy hit.

tara_engineer: agree. propose rollout policy: 70/30 compact-v2 for 60m, measure p95, failure if error rate >0.5% or p95 not improved by >=8%. then move to 90/10 for 2h, then full swap. Also run evals using their activation prompt set (eval name: activation-500).

jamie_cs: I can coordinate with CSM to collect quick quality feedback from the activation cohort during canary. Dina, can you get 5-10 real prompts in the eval set and ask customers to flag quality regressions? keep it lightweight.

dina_csm: on it — will pull 8 recent prompts and drop into the shared doc. will ping product owners for a 15-min window to flag any awkward outputs.

eli_sre: config snippet for routing we plan to push (small rollout):

```yaml
routing_policy: 
  - target: chat.summarize
    variants:
      - model: standard-v3
        weight: 0.7
      - model: compact-v2-int8
        weight: 0.3
    canary: 60m
    rollback_conditions:
      - metric: error_rate
        operator: '>'
        threshold: 0.005
      - metric: p95_latency
        operator: '<='
        threshold: -0.08 # relative improvement required
```

eli_sre: I'll schedule the canary for the next low-traffic activation window (tomorrow 09:00 UTC). opsbot will post deploy note to #eng-oncall.

opsbot: Scheduled canary for BeaconHealth: 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC. Rolling policy set to 70/30 compact-v2-int8 for 60m. Monitoring hooks: p95, error_rate, token_cost.

tara_engineer: after 60m, we should snapshot logs and run the activation-500 eval. If quality issues show up, we revert and try reduced sequence length or prefix-cache tweak.

jamie_cs: thanks all. i'll message the customer with expected plan and ask for light QA help. will report back in ~2.5h after canary ends. :thumbsup:
